description: Manage and monitor an OmniRoute AI gateway from VS Code: provider quota and health, combos, usage and cost analytics, server control, plus its models and MCP tools in Copilot Chat.
welcome.offline:
OmniRoute is not reachable at the configured URL.
[Start OmniRoute](command:omniroute.startServer)
[Change URL](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22omniroute.baseUrl%22%5D)
OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that routes to hundreds of providers with automatic fallback. [Learn more](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute)
welcome.needsKey:
OmniRoute is running but needs an API key for its /v1 API.
[Set API Key](command:omniroute.setApiKey)
[Sign In with Admin Password](command:omniroute.signIn)
Signing in lets the extension create a key for you.
command.configureCli: Configure a CLI Tool to Use OmniRoute
command.runCli: Run a CLI Tool through OmniRoute
config.baseUrl: URL of your OmniRoute server (without `/v1`). Default port is `20128`.
config.pollIntervalSeconds: How often to refresh health, models and analytics (seconds).
config.requestTimeoutSeconds: Timeout for management and model-list requests (seconds). Chat requests are not limited.
config.server.launchMode: How Start Server launches OmniRoute: npx (no install), a global npm install, Docker, or your own command.
config.server.customCommand: Command used when the launch mode is 'custom'.
config.server.port: Port for a server started from VS Code (PORT). Keep omniroute.baseUrl in sync.
config.server.dataDir: Data directory for a server started from VS Code (DATA_DIR). Empty uses OmniRoute's default (~/.omniroute).
config.server.localhostOnly: Bind a server started from VS Code to 127.0.0.1 only, so other machines on the network cannot reach it.
config.server.autoStart: Start OmniRoute when VS Code starts if it is not already running.
config.copilot.enabled: Offer OmniRoute models in the Copilot Chat model picker.
config.copilot.includeAutoModels: Offer OmniRoute's zero-config `auto/*` models (auto, auto/coding, auto/fast, auto/cheap…).
config.copilot.includeCombos: Offer your enabled combos (multi-model fallback chains).
config.copilot.models: Extra model IDs from the OmniRoute catalog to offer in Copilot, e.g. `openai/gpt-5.4`. Use **OmniRoute: Choose Copilot Models**.
config.copilot.contextWindow: Context window reported to Copilot for models whose size OmniRoute does not report.
config.chat.compression: Prompt compression for Copilot requests (`X-OmniRoute-Compression`). `server` uses the gateway's own setting.
config.chat.bypassCache: Skip OmniRoute's semantic response cache for Copilot requests.
config.chat.disableMemory: Do not use OmniRoute's persistent memory for Copilot requests.
config.chat.showReasoning: Show model reasoning as a quoted block above the answer.
config.chat.routingNotice: Show which provider and model served the last Copilot request, with its cost and latency.
config.mcp.enabled: Register OmniRoute's MCP server (its management and routing tools) with VS Code. The server must have MCP enabled and your API key needs the `mcp` scope.
